question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing left winger, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing fullback, Eve is playing cheerleader, Fred is playing striker, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Fred and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) left winger
(C) right midfielder
(D) fullback
(E) cheerleader
(F) striker
(G) right winger
solution:
Positions in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: right back, left winger, right midfielder, fullback, cheerleader, striker, right winger
1. Bob ↔ Dave: right back, fullback, right midfielder, left winger, cheerleader, striker, right winger
2. Bob ↔ Gertrude: right back, right winger, right midfielder, left winger, cheerleader, striker, fullback
3. Eve ↔ Claire: right back, right winger, cheerleader, left winger, right midfielder, striker, fullback
4. Eve ↔ Bob: right back, right midfielder, cheerleader, left winger, right winger, striker, fullback
5. Eve ↔ Bob: right back, right winger, cheerleader, left winger, right midfielder, striker, fullback
6. Claire ↔ Bob: right back, cheerleader, right winger, left winger, right midfielder, striker, fullback
7. Fred ↔ Claire: right back, cheerleader, striker, left winger, right midfielder, right winger, fullback
Fred is playing right winger, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
